scope: Nine original mapped-land RUS/KAZ contacts, exactly partitioned 6 + 2 + 1 by the three inspected treaty sheets.
question: Can actual primary treaty evidence resolve the retained competing KAZ contact sufficiently to justify the original RUS repair?
performed: Authenticated the complete nine original owner/contact/class tuples against the retained held partition and original repair-or-documented-exception contract.

Read actual UN Treaty I-52717 text and its published Annex 2 maps, then the official Adilet Russian treaty and Annex 1. Original source, physical and native evidence remain bound to their literal executions.

For M-39-61, replaced the ineffective one-axis/global grid method with a coupled local fit and two held-out controls, inspected original embedded JPEGs on three adjacent sheets, confirmed the named Maly Uzen and Barfolomeevskoe reservoir, corrected the 36.6/38.6 label distinction, and tested the 22.8-to-point-76 positional context against the printed grid.

For N-41-69, examined the actual Tobol route and island exceptions, performed a four-corner comparison checked against four interior grid crossings, then a local affine fit checked against two new crossings. Native-resolution JPEG and conditional datum alternatives were actually inspected.

For N-41-68, examined the exact native JPEG, geographic corners, four independent projected-grid crossings, local marginal country labels and the Tobol clause. The nearby oxbow was not invented as one of the treaty island exceptions.

Distinct reviewers inspected the actual records and pixels and evaluated remaining finite steps. No endpoint marker on every sheet, universal modern certificate or exhaustive worldwide search was imposed.

result_by_group.M-39-61: The named river-reservoir sequence supports applicability, but red, blue and dark channel/bank linework overlaps at the six exact placements. The bounded anchor checks add context without isolating a robust per-key treaty stroke.
result_by_group.N-41-69: Both exact placements meet the broad Tobol channel/boundary corridor; the tighter bend and conditional datum variation prevent a robust per-key distinction. The text does not identify either center as an island exception.
result_by_group.N-41-68: The source map is adverse to dismissing the Kostanay contact. The point is adjacent to the printed river-border corridor on its Kazakhstan-labeled side, but stroke width and datum realization do not establish an exact country assignment.

why_researched_unresolved: Substantial actual source-specific text, map, control, native-image and conditional-coordinate investigation did not resolve these nine original competing contacts. The independent assessments support a narrow unresolved proposal. This is not a claim that every possible future source has been searched: a new detailed coordinate/route witness may justify further work, but no such operand is fabricated or treated as a universally required certificate.
limits: All three maps are generalized 1:100,000 treaty-annex sheets with a printed 1942 coordinate-system label. The selected Pulkovo realizations and datum operations are conditional.

Fitting residuals and held-out image checks describe registration, not survey accuracy, map uncertainty or a qualification tolerance. Controls used in later fitting are not simultaneously called independent validation.
Natural river or reservoir changes do not themselves move the treaty boundary under Article 4. No modern watercourse was substituted for the treaty map.
No positive repair, negative-contact deletion, native hold removal, present sovereignty decision or full-package completion is asserted.

literal_execution_reuse.truth: Historical code executed these unchanged scientific operands. New manual map work is recorded separately; no result is relabeled as execution by current code.
